INSERT INTO organization_members (
            organization_id,
            display_name,
            external_reference,
            requested_authorized_wallet,
            requested_roles,
            lifecycle_status
        )
        VALUES (
            $1,
            $2,
            $3,
            $4,
            $5,
            $6
        )
        RETURNING
            organization_id,
            member_id,
            display_name,
            external_reference,
            requested_authorized_wallet,
            requested_roles,
            lifecycle_status,
            created_at,
            updated_at
